people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: Nathan said to the king, “Go, do all that is in your heart; for Yahweh is with you.”
translations.bsb: And Nathan replied to the king, “Go and do all that is in your heart, for the LORD is with you.”
translations.kjv: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.
translations.asv: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thy heart; for Jehovah is with thee.
